verdict.rationale: Skyfire exposes an MCP server that lets AI agents discover sellers and create/charge tokens via structured tool calls (find-sellers, create-kya-token, etc.), which is a form of agentic operation, but this is tool invocation via defined MCP functions rather than free-form natural-language command interpretation by the product itself. There's no evidence of a chat/NL interface where a user types plain-English instructions that Skyfire parses and executes directly. missing for 10: evidence of a natural-language interface or NL-to-action translation layer, documentation of NL command parsing, independent corroboration of conversational usage beyond structured MCP tool calls.
